critical_findings: Seven-core architecture remains useful as a retrieval/reasoning ontology when treated as overlapping containers rather than biological compartments.
Information-seeking content was removed from C1 and returned to motivation; sustained attention/vigilance was added to C1.
Trust was removed from the C3 relationship module and retained primarily in C5.
Psychological framing (C4) is separated from deliberate message construction (C7).
Ethos/pathos/logos are retained as rhetorical organizing concepts but not treated as mechanistic primitives.
Generic psycholinguistics was replaced with operational language-processing mechanisms.
unresolved_noncritical: Processing fluency versus comprehension boundary requires deeper S3 research.
Affective forecasting versus expectancy/value overlap requires deeper S3 research.
Social proof versus descriptive norms requires node-level de-duplication.
Metacognition/self-validation substructure requires focused evidence review.
Proof/reason-to-believe must be translated from applied terminology into scientific mechanisms.
Information structure/register/tone requires finer linguistic decomposition.
Message sequencing, pacing and CTA modules require stronger evidence mapping.
